name: THE SCHOOL
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: A school's gym is where a town is sent in a disaster: the Red Cross's shelter list is mostly schools, their gyms full of cots. This one never emptied.
Bleachers pulled out from the wall are steps a man climbs over, not a stand: on house tiles they are rough ground with low cover, never high ground.
The classroom wing is rooms off one hallway, its lockers lining both walls; a classroom has a door at each end and those doors are the only ways in and out of it, so the doors are the fight.
On house tiles a classroom is a little smaller than a tile's run of desks: a room is a few tiles of desks, and the wall between two rooms is a partition.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (school_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The school is its own map kind: six fights in ten there are fought inside it, by the cell's own dice; the rest in its yard or on the street.

school.name: THE SCHOOL
school.floor_areas_why: COMBAT FOUR 11/22, COOK SIX's ask: one floor kind served both layouts, so the gym had no court and the hallway no hall tile. The gym's floor between its bleachers is 'court', the classrooms' hallway between the locker rows is 'hall'; each draws the school's floor until COOK's art names that kind.

tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The school's block wall: no way through.

partition.effect: The wall between two classrooms: no way through.

lockers.effect: A run of lockers along the hallway, doors hanging: no way through but the classroom doors. [bb] its palisade.

floor.effect: The gym's court or the hallway's tile: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

doorway.effect: A classroom's doorway, the door gone: open ground, one of the room's two ways in or out.

bleachers.effect: Bleachers pulled out from the wall: steps you climb over (3 AP), low cover; not high enough to be high ground. [bb] its brush.

cots.effect: A row of shelter cots, blankets and bags still on them: low cover.

mats.effect: Gym mats stacked on their cart: low cover.

tables.effect: Cafeteria tables folded up on their wheels: cover.

desks.effect: Rows of student desks, some on their sides: low cover.

barricade.effect: Desks and chairs piled against the doorway's side of the room: cover.

case.effect: The trophy case pulled into the hallway, its glass gone: cover.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a trash can. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The doors to the yard, chained open: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The yard doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in school_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.

sc_bleachers_n.name: BLEACHERS
sc_bleachers_n.why: COMBAT FOUR 11/22, COOK SIX's ask: the gym's SOUTH bleachers, which must step up to the south and face the court. One picture served both rows, so the south row faced away. Until COOK's own picture for this name is in, it is drawn as the north bleachers (sc_bleachers: this inside's own finished piece).

start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: the bleachers are steps, not a stand. The doors are the board.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): a school's dropped ceiling (the classrooms) and the gym's roof deck, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the hospital's grid).
